title: Diffusion MRI — FSL DTIFIT tutorial workflow
description: Portfolio scaffold for a compact FSL diffusion-tensor workflow covering optional TOPUP and EDDY correction, DTIFIT estimation, FA and MD maps, ROI summaries, and documented limitations. The repository describes a planned workflow and does not claim completed quantitative results.
notes: Portfolio scaffold. The archived repository documents a planned workflow and does not claim completed scientific results.
